# Diagrammatic

Diagrammatic is a static web app for creating consulting-grade diagrams, tables, matrix charts, and branded hero images.

## Primary Pages

- [Landing page](https://www.diagrammatic.in/) - product overview, framework library, pricing, and early-access contact.
- [Diagrammatic Studio](https://studio.diagrammatic.in/) - browser-based diagram, table, and matrix chart generator.
- [Hero Generator](https://www.diagrammatic.in/hero) - branded hero image and social card generator.
- [Privacy](https://www.diagrammatic.in/privacy) - static-site privacy summary.

## Machine-Readable Resources

- [Sitemap](https://www.diagrammatic.in/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots policy](https://www.diagrammatic.in/robots.txt)
